findings.comment: CI failure, PR 80 run 39458745094 at 4fb92a92 (class: a test that runs the hook with a real process tree above it)
findings.text: The no-worker hook test ran the hook with the real process tree above it. On the pc1 runner that tree holds the real Runner.Worker, which the hook found and ended with SIGKILL, so the CI job died in its test step. Repro: run the hook tests under a process named Runner.Worker. Fix: run that case in a PID namespace with its own /proc, keep its assertions, and run the whole hook test file under an outer stand-in worker that must survive.
